info.title: Aura Pool Automation API
info.description: REST JSON. Money is integer minor units (KSh 50 = 5000) in KES. Times are ISO 8601 UTC. Money-moving POSTs take an Idempotency-Key header. Lists use cursor pagination (`cursor`, `limit`, `nextCursor`). Every error has the shape { error: { code, message, details? } }.
